summary: The agent correctly avoids data leakage by computing imputation statistics solely on the training data. However, the solution lacks a validation split and any feature engineering. Most critically, it introduces a feature mismatch by filtering the test set to an unordered subset of columns while leaving the training set unfiltered, causing a fatal execution error during prediction.
